service.description: What EventDetail shows of an event the user may see (found false, or visible false: "not available"): the facts of ironstone.commons.CalendarServices.get#EventFacts (for instanceStart, an instance of a recurring event), the edit values of its When and Overview, the recurrence editor's fields (of its series), the user's reminders, the calendars it may go in, the people's free/busy at its time (get#FreeBusy: busy, tentative or free), the meeting rooms with their availability then, the attendees who have not had the latest invitation (pendingInvites), the records it is on (linkedRecordList: its request, task, page and other records through RequestWorkEffort, WikiPageWorkEffort or WorkEffortRecord, and the work efforts of its WorkEffortAssoc rows other than the instances of a series, each one the user may see: get#RecordLinkInfo checkOnly; when and by whom it was linked, and whether the user may take it off), and what the user may do.

Puts the event on a record (EventDetail's LinkedRecords, the record picked by an id through mantle.GeneralServices.lookup#ById or the search index, ironstone.comms.InboxServices.search#LinkRecords): for a user who may change the event (get#EventAccessInfo, edit), a record the user may see, through mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.link#WorkEffortRecord (the record's own join, RequestWorkEffort or WikiPageWorkEffort, else a WorkEffortRecord, which checks the record under the user's filters). record is "entity|id" as the picker answers, or recordEntityName and recordId.

Takes the event off a record (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.unlink#WorkEffortRecord: the own join row or the WorkEffortRecord), for a user who may change the event; the record stays. A work effort association is the plan's (Projects) and stays.

actions.script: unlinked = false ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.CalendarServices.get#EventAccessInfo').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, need: 'edit'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.unlink#WorkEffortRecord').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, recordEntityName: recordEntityName, recordId: recordId}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return unlinked = !!out?.unlinked message = ec.l10n.localize(unlinked ? 'Taken off the record' : 'It was not linked')

service.description: The When and Overview of EventDetail: name, all day, start and end (a date and a time each), location, join link (infoUrl), description and visibility, by scope for a recurring event (mantle.work.EventServices.update#EventOccurrence: this, following or all); a new calendar puts the event (its series) in that calendar in place of the user's other ones (add#CalendarEvent, remove#CalendarEvent). With notify Y the attendees get the update. A new time that clashes with another booking of the event's room or equipment is refused unless allowConflicts (the booking stays, and conflictList names the clashes).

parameter.name: allowConflicts
parameter.description: Y keeps a booking that clashes at the new time

parameter.name: targetInstanceStart
parameter.description: The selected occurrence after the change, or empty when showing a new target's own time.

service.description: The repeat of an event (its series) from the recurrence editor's fields (ironstone.commons.CalendarServices.make#RRule), stored by mantle.work.EventServices.store#EventRecurrence; NONE makes it a single event again.

Invites people to an event (edit access): parties (partyIds) and email addresses (emails, comma or space separated: a person with that address the user may see, else a new personal contact of the user's), each a current WorkEffortParty (Assignee, WeptOffered, mustRsvp Y) with expectationEnumId WepeInvRequired, or WepeInvRequested when optional. Invitations go out with send#EventInvitations (the screen's Send invitations, or sendNow Y).
Marks an attendee required (WepeInvRequired) or optional (WepeInvRequested), edit access.

Sends the invitations of an event to its new or changed attendees (mantle.work.EventServices.send#EventInvitations, edit access; partyIds limits it, resendAll sends to everyone), with an optional note; message says how many went and which were skipped (no user and no email address).

The user's reminders of an event (its series), as the Reminders box changes them: add (offsetMinutes and methodEnumId) or remove (reminderSeqId) one, the others kept (mantle.work.EventServices.store#WorkEffortReminders, which needs the user on the event).

Books a meeting room (facilityId) or equipment (assetId) for an event at its time (mantle.work.EventServices.book#Resource, edit access): booked at once, or requested when the resource has a booking policy (approvers). A clash with another booking is refused with the events it clashes with.
Cancels the booking of a meeting room or equipment of an event (mantle.work.EventServices.cancel#ResourceBooking, edit access).

A copy of an event the user may see (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.clone#WorkEffort): the same time, place, description, repeat and calendars (those the user may add to, else the user's default), the attendees invited again (not answered, no invitation yet), the user its organizer; the copy is planned, and nobody is told until Send invitations.

An event the user may see as an .ics file (the ICalendar tool's write, PUBLISH, over mantle.work.EventServices.get#EventIcsMaps: the series with its changed instances), written to the user's export folder for the screen to send as a download.
